toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html","edit_description":"Create this new single-file, polished classic Snake game. Use HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript only (no dependencies). Include a responsive 30x30 canvas-style grid rendered in a canvas, clearly styled start menu, scoreboard, instructions, and game-over overlay. Start menu must offer three buttons/modes: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU. Run two colored snakes simultaneously. Human player 1 uses Arrow keys; human player 2 uses WASD. Each snake moves continuously, grows when consuming randomly placed food, and dies upon hitting walls, itself, or the other snake; when a snake dies it stops while the other can continue until all active snakes are dead. Show live scores. CPU snakes should automatically seek food using safe greedy movement: consider valid non-reversing neighboring cells, avoid walls and all occupied snake cells (with allowance for their own tail when not growing), choose option minimizing Manhattan distance to food, with safe randomized tie-breaking/fallback. Let Escape return to mode selection. Ensure keyboard inputs prevent scrolling for game control keys. Make it visually high quality: dark navy background, glass panels, colorful green/teal and orange/pink snake treatments, attractive food glow, grid, responsive sizing. Add an introductory overlay until mode chosen. Ensure all requested functionality works coherently."}
